title: Chapter 351 Looking For God
content:
Chapter 351 Looking For God

Looking at his granddaughter's well-behaved appearance, Old Man Jiang showed a loving smile and then looked at Lu Daosheng who had already sat on the sofa in the living room.

"Xiaosen, did you live in the Lin family last night?"

Mr. Jiang asked nervously.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and said, "No, I went out to do something and stayed outside."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's answer, Mr. Jiang nodded slightly and did not ask any more questions.

In the next period of time, Lu Daosheng did not choose to investigate God or find any inspiration. Instead, he stayed in the Jiang family and accompanied Mr. Jiang and Jiang Xiaoxiao.

It's like this, day after day, year after year.

These days, Mr. Jiang feels that it is the happiest period of his life.

Not only is it very good in health and delicious in every way you eat, but it is also accompanied by the company of your own granddaughter and godson. At the same time, the strength of the Jiang family is also beginning to flourish.

It's like death without regrets.

I don't know how many years later.

In the Jiang family villa, Mr. Jiang was lying on the Grand Master's chair, basking in the sun comfortably.

As can be seen from the naked eye, he is already very old.

At this time, Lu Daosheng appeared beside him.

At this moment, some white frost appeared on Lu Daosheng's head.

"Young man."

Old Master Jiang raised his eyes lightly, and when he saw that it was Lu Daosheng, he narrowed his eyes again.

Seeing Mr. Jiang like this, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and said slowly, "Mr., I may be leaving."

While talking, Lu Daosheng felt a little nervous.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Mr. Jiang did not have any major mental fluctuations, but just sighed softly.

"I guessed this day would be there."

"Jin Lin, how could it be an object in the pond?"

Lu Daosheng was silent.

It turns out that the old man had known it a long time ago.

"Mr., what instructions do you have?"

Hearing this, Old Master Jiang opened his eyes wide with some difficulty, looked at Lu Daosheng and said, "Can you bring Xiaoxiao, is that good?"

Looking at Mr. Jiang's turbid but pleading eyes, Lu Daosheng looked stern.

"good."

He agreed.

Of course, even if Mr. Jiang doesn't say it, he will still bring Jiang Xiaoxiao with him.

Because if he left in the entire Blue Star, Jiang Xiaoxiao would have no support.

Maybe she will live the rest of her life with countless wealth, but that is definitely not the life she hopes for.

"Mr., don't you want to be with me?"

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng looked at Mr. Jiang and asked again.

Perhaps, this question is the most important thing for him.

Looking at Mr. Jiang and waiting for the other party's answer, Lu Daosheng suddenly calmed down.

He had thought about it before, but at this time, he suddenly felt relieved.

No matter what the old man said, he would accept it.

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Old Master Jiang showed a gratified smile.

In this life, he had shown many such smiles to Lu Daosheng, but no one could compare to this time.

"My? Haha, I won't go. I've lived here all my life and I can't live without this place."

"Xiaoxiao will leave it to you to take care of in the future."

"You know, she has no parents since she was a child."

Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Old man, don't worry about this."

After a while, Mr. Jiang left and left the world peacefully.

At the funeral, many internationally renowned people came to the scene.

But most of them are not familiar with Mr. Jiang.

Because the old man’s friends have basically left.

He is the longest-lived of them.

The rest are just their juniors.

"Brother Sheng, I feel so uncomfortable."

After the funeral, Jiang Xiaoxiao suddenly grabbed Lu Daosheng and lowered her head and choked slightly.

Today, Jiang Xiaoxiao has become an older single woman.

She was not married.

In her words, there is nothing I like.

In this matter, Mr. Jiang didn't say anything, let alone Lu Daosheng.

But what is strange is that Jiang Xiaoxiao still looks very young to this day.

When walking on the road, some young men even asked for contact information. I never thought that the beautiful woman in front of me could already be the other person's mother.

Looking at Jiang Xiaoxiao in front of him, Lu Daosheng patted the other party on the shoulder.

"You still have me."

This sentence made Jiang Xiaoxiao cry.

Yes, she still has a brother, but only her brother is.

One day after the funeral of the old man in the Jiang family, a major news exploded like a bomb in the entire Yunshan City.

All Jiangjia properties were sold and donated to charity organizations.

The head of the Jiang family disappeared.

The Jiang family, which was at its peak in Yunshan City, disappeared overnight!

Everyone was talking about this.

There are all kinds of statements.

Even the saying that the Jiang family was taken away by aliens spread.

And somewhere in China at this time.

However, Lu Daosheng took Jiang Xiaoxiao directly on a trip.

Of course, Lu Daosheng also taught Jiang Xiaoxiao a very important thing - cultivation.

Although the Blue Star spiritual energy is scarce, Lu Daosheng discovered that it is not impossible to have any rare.

As long as you use some special methods, it can still be found.

For Jiang Xiaoxiao, who has just entered the cultivation stage, that little spiritual energy is enough.

Anyway, sooner or later, he will take Jiang Xiaoxiao back to the deserted city.

So, Lu Daosheng took Jiang Xiaoxiao to teach the methods of cultivation while traveling around, leaving some bizarre legends everywhere.

What is the void that attracts thunder, what is the air that takes objects, and what is the lightness of the water floating on the water.

Finally one day.

A mysterious man who claimed to be from God found Lu Daosheng.

"Friend, are you interested in getting to know God?"

In front of Lu Daosheng and Jiang Xiaoxiao, a middle-aged man with long hair dressed in coarse linen and mysterious patterns on his face clasped his fists slightly at the two of them, with a faint smile on his face.

"Are you finally here?"

Looking at the middle-aged man in front of him who claimed to be from God, Lu Daosheng said calmly.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, a hint of surprise surged in the middle-aged man's eyes.

"Your Excellency has known that we will come to you?"

Lu Daosheng did not answer this question, but said lightly: "Take me there, God."

Now, the middle-aged man suddenly hesitated.

Although the above order was to ask him to explore the reality of this strange man and the reality, and then bring him to God.

But now, he always feels uncomfortable.

I'm afraid this guy in front of me will be a little difficult to master.

Is it really good to bring such an unknown existence to God?

Suddenly, the middle-aged man was in the same place, hesitating.

Lu Daosheng said nothing about this, just stared at the middle-aged man in front of him quietly.

Since the other party has appeared, Lu Daosheng has no doubts.

Over the years, he has not simply traveled around the mountains and rivers, but has been seriously looking for all inspirations about the new world.

But in the end, he found nothing.

Then now there is only the last unexplored place left.

That is God.
